name: Slicker
long_description: Slicker eliminates involuntary churn through AI-powered retries, tailored for your business. Our proprietary engine automatically monitors, detects, and recovers failed recurring payments, so you can convert past due invoices into revenue.
one_liner: Recover payment failures and maximize subscription Revenue

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Dani Penev is the co-founder and CEO of Slicker, the AI-powered subscription failure recovery platform. He has multiple years of experience in payments, having built global bank transfer solutions at Stripe and Thought Machine. Dani graduated from the University of Glasgow where he worked on a food-delivery startup with his co-founder.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Ivan Valkov is the co-founder and CTO of Slicker, the AI-powered subscription failure recovery platform. He has built and scaled products and teams in companies ranging from early-stage startups to large corporations. Ivan co-hosts a podcast and will publish his fantasy novel one day.
